# Charts Examples

图表组件共享数据、series、legend、tooltip 和 axes 模式，细节看 chart 类型源。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## PieChart

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/pie-chart/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/pie-chart/`.

Note: `innerRadiusRatio` 做环形（0.6 为甜甜圈）。`centerValue`/`centerLabel` 写在洞里。

Vue: `<PieChart :data="data" />`

React: `<PieChart data={data} />`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
